00043 MaximaUGenInternal::MaximaUGenInternal(UGen const& input) throw()
00044 : UGenInternal(NumInputs) // Initialise the UGenIntenal's UGen inputs array using the enum size.

00047   didIncreaseLastTime = false;

00056 void MaximaUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00057 {
00058   // Get the number of samples to process this block.
00059   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00060   
00061   // Get a pointer to the output sample array.
00062   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00063   
00064   // Get a pointer to the input sample array.
00065   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00066   
00067   // The dsp loop:
00068   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00069   {
00070     float input = *inputSamples;  // Pull a sample out of the input array.
00071     
00072     bool didIncreaseThisTime;
00073     
00074     if(input > lastValue)
00075       didIncreaseThisTime = true;
00076     else
00077       didIncreaseThisTime = false;
00078     
00079     float output;
00080     
00081     if((didIncreaseThisTime == false) && (didIncreaseLastTime == true))
00082       output = 1.f;
00083     else
00084       output = 0.f;
00085     
00086     lastValue = input;
00087     didIncreaseLastTime = didIncreaseThisTime;
00088     
00089     *outputSamples = output;    // Put a sample into the output array.
00090     
00091     // Increment the array pointers for the next loop iteration.
00092     inputSamples++;   
00093     outputSamples++;
00094   }
00095 }
